description: This file defines a service module for task management, including functions to fetch, create, update, and delete tasks via Supabase RPC calls and database views. It also defines related types and interfaces for tasks.

methods.name: fetchMyTasks
methods.description: Fetches tasks for the current authenticated user from the 'public.tasks' view, enforcing RLS policies.

methods.name: createMyTask
methods.description: Creates a new task with the specified title via the 'tasks_insert' RPC, defaulting other fields.

methods.name: updateMyTaskStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a task identified by its UUID via the 'tasks_update' RPC.

methods.name: deleteMyTask
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by its UUID via the 'tasks_delete' RPC.
